questions.prompt: Which is the best one-sentence definition of an operating system?
options: A program that acts as an intermediary between the user of a computer and the computer hardware
The program you use to browse the web
The physical chips inside a computer
A program that translates source code into machine code

questions.prompt: Application programs usually talk to the hardware directly, without going through the operating system.
Which of these is NOT one of the three goals of an operating system?
options: Execute user programs and make solving user problems easier
Make every program run in the same amount of time
Make the computer system convenient to use

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: the four components of a computer system are hardware, the operating system, application programs, and ______. (one word)
A web browser, a compiler, and a video game are all examples of which component?
In the four-component picture, a "user" can be another computer, not only a person.
CPU, memory, and I/O devices belong to which component?
Which component controls and coordinates the use of the hardware among the various applications and users? (two words)
